siglip_primary.notes: Primary Phase 1 image relevance evaluator. Pinned to a verified Hugging Face model revision. Current Hugging Face model page does not show an active Inference Provider deployment, so Phase 1 uses local/ephemeral Transformers execution.

blip_caption_candidate.notes: Secondary descriptive evaluator only. Hugging Face warns that the legacy image-to-text pipeline path is not supported in Transformers v5; direct model loading must be qualified before enabling.

model_promotion_rule: No model may move from candidate/shadow status to production authority without fresh capability, security, licence, cost and business-value evidence.
